# EfficientNet-Lite1

Classification · `efficientnet-lite1_240x240` · DX-APP Python example

Classification model, evaluated on ImageNet (ILSVRC2012).

**Input** 240 × 240 × 3 · **Dataset** ImageNet (ILSVRC2012) · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![EfficientNet-Lite1 output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models EfficientNet_Lite1
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/efficientnet/efficientnet-lite1_240x240/efficientnet-lite1_240x240_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/efficientnet-lite1_240x240.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target efficientnet-lite1_240x240_sync   # once
./bin/efficientnet-lite1_240x240_sync \
  -m assets/models/efficientnet-lite1_240x240.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 76.42 |
| Q-Lite | 76.27 (−0.15) |
| Q-Pro | 71.08 (−5.34) |

ImageNet (ILSVRC2012) · difference vs Raw in brackets.

> **Note:** Q-Pro is 5.34 points below Raw on Top1.
